# Sound source slot role

<!-- Generated by `loom modules --markdown` from the role descriptor. -->

Makes a sound. An oscillator plays at its pitch, or follows a phase cable.

ID `loom.role.source` · Version 1

## Inputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pitch (`pitch`) | pitch | Optional | Sets the frequency. 0 is middle C, and +0.1 is one octave up. |
| Phase (`phase`) | phase | Optional | Position in the wave, from 0 to 1. Replaces the source's own phase. |

## Outputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Out (`out`) | audio | Required | The sound. |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Unit | Values | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level (`level`) |  | Continuous | Optional | How loud the sound is, from 0 to 1. |
| Tune (`tune`) | st | Continuous | Optional | Shifts the pitch in semitones. |
| Octave (`octave`) | oct | Continuous | Optional | Shifts the pitch in octaves. |

## Modules that fill this role

- [Noise](loom.osc.noise.md)
- [Pulse](loom.osc.pulse.md)
- [Saw](loom.osc.saw.md)
- [Sine](loom.osc.sine.md)
